message.content:
Now you need to enter the message "Your dentist appointment is scheduled for 2 PM on Thursday." in the input box. First, you need to activate the input box, so click on the input box (the area corresponding to the EditText), and then enter the text. The corresponding element for the input box is [136, 920, 862, 972], so first perform the Tap action to activate the input box, and then enter the text. Therefore, this step is to click the input box first.


do(action="Tap", element=[499,946])
